newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's KFA buys 52,500 tonnes of corn-traders.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's KFA buys 52,500 tonnes of corn-traders.

text.p: The Pusan division of South Korea's Korea Feed Association (KFA) bought 52,500 tonnes of corn from Cargill, traders said on Monday.
Traders said the purchase was made at $132.97 a tonne C&F if sourced from the U.S. Gulf, at $133.77 a tonne C&F if from the Pacific Northwest or at $128.77 a tonne C&F if from China.
They said shipment was set for August 6-25 if sourced from the U.S. Gulf, for August 22-September 10 if from the Pacific Northwest or for September 6-25 if from China.
Arrival was scheduled by September 25 to the southeastern ports of Pusan and Ulsan.
